value.rationale: A complete first nontrivial fixed-degree contact-network class displays strict first-order outbreak-size stochastic dominance at every interior transmissibility, yet exactly one reversal of variance ordering. This is a precise structural difference between average outbreak burden and uncertainty while holding network size, edge count and every vertex degree fixed. It answers a natural modeled epidemic comparison rather than tabulating an arbitrary isolated example, and quantifies the sole variance switch with an exact algebraic theorem.
